caveats: Retrospective saved-instance evaluation; correctness/formulation selection used previously inspected instances.
Between-search differences confound objective, pulse family, and formulation/layout menu; descriptive comparisons cannot isolate objective effects.
Assignment: each32-trial TPE run compared separately with one32-trial random run; no pooled-best TPE claim. Random reference is reused, not independent evidence.
Ground:24 fresh trials plus12 shared cached warm starts per study; three optimizer seeds retained; no random comparator exists.
TV<0.001 between successive approximations is empirical absolute stability, not certified error or rare-event relative accuracy.
No best-of-shot probabilities are exported. The single separate rare-tail case does not validate all winner/case/model combinations.
Means/minima are descriptive. Optimizer seeds and interaction arms are not independent problem instances.
